info.title: Chillin' in My 30s after Getting Fired from the Demon King's Army
info.synopsis: Il trentenne Dariel è un soldato dell'esercito del nuovo Re dei Demoni che non è in grado di usare la magia, e per questa ragione viene cacciato. Tuttavia, dopo aver salvato una ragazza in una foresta, viene invitato nel suo villaggio e pian piano si rende conto di essere considerabilmente più forte di quanto avesse pensato...

episodes.title: Dariel viene licenziato
episodes.synopsis: Dariel is fired from his position as a dark soldier in the Demon King’s army and finds himself at a complete loss. In the forest, he happens to rescue a girl named Malika, who takes him to a human village called Lux where his hectic second life begins.

episodes.title: Dariel svolge il suo primo incarico da avventuriero
episodes.synopsis: Dariel's first quests as an adventurer go smoothly, but the village's other adventurer, Gashita, continues to see him as the enemy. Word that a high level monster has appeared near the village arrives. Dariel heads into the forest to bring Gashita back.

episodes.title: Dariel torna dove lavorava prima
episodes.synopsis: Dariel learns that Lux Village once flourished due to a nearby mine. When the demons took it, they condemned the village to a slow death. As the mine is Dariel’s old workplace, he decides to visit it to see if there’s anything he can do for his new home.

episodes.title: Dariel Negozia
episodes.synopsis: Bashbarza is in a rage after being reprimanded by the Demon King for losing the mythril mine. Meanwhile, in Lux Village, the mood is a celebratory one. Dariel runs into an old coworker and sees an opportunity to prevent conflict between humans and demons.

episodes.title: Dariel si batte a duello
episodes.synopsis: Lux Village is starting to thrive, thanks to the Mythril Mine, but Fittbitan has taken control of the forge. The arrival of a legendary swordsmith makes Fittbitan view Dariel with even more hostility, and so the adventurer challenges Dariel to a duel.

episodes.title: Dariel, avvolto dal vapore

episodes.title: Dariel usa una certa abilità
episodes.synopsis: The Hero, Laidy, has two objectives: to have new mythril weapons made, and to find a new ally to help defeat the Demon King. Laidy becomes aware of Dariel's true abilities and asks him to join her party. Dariel declines, but Laidy refuses to accept it.

episodes.title: Dariel si occupa di alcune questioni
episodes.synopsis: The General of Wind, Zebiantes, arrives in Lux Village with certain demands after hearing rumors of mythril. Even after Dariel manages to settle things with her, he realizes he has another problem—he can’t let Laidy and Zebiantes clash!

episodes.title: Dariel si ricongiunge
episodes.synopsis: The strongest Hero, Alantsil, has come to visit. Unable to forgive the demons for the tragedy in his past, Alantsil attacks Zebiantes. Dariel tries to convince Alantsil not to fight, but to no avail. As they talk, the secret of Dariel's birth is revealed!

episodes.title: Dariel, circondato di scintille
episodes.synopsis: Alantsil, the previous Hero, and Granbarza, formerly one of the Four Generals, confront each other. One wrong move could bring them to blows. Meanwhile, Bashbarza’s hatred for Dariel explodes, and he heads off to do something about it.

episodes.title: Dariel regola i conti
episodes.synopsis: Dariel and the others rush to the Mythril Mine on a rescue mission, but the Magical Fire Beast, Salamandra appears in their path. Dariel presses ahead with their rescue efforts, but Bashbarza, who has obtained tremendous power, has other ideas.

episodes.synopsis: Humans and demons take a stand to protect what is dear to them. During the fight, Dariel comes into contact with Bashbarza's memories and the two men's emotions collide. What will be their future, and the future of Lux Village?
